blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. Sale and lease listings.

Office space for sale and lease in Langley: office buildings and office strata units listed on the MLS®. Space for lease is included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: The City of Langley’s Official Community Plan sets out to encourage office space near the planned 196 Street and 203 Street SkyTrain stations, for example by exempting one floor of office from floor area limits. ([City of Langley Official Community Plan](https://www.langleycity.ca/media/file/ocp-official-community-plan-bylaw-r), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 4 of the 20 commercial sales in Langley were office properties, against 46 across the Lower Mainland.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
Township of Langley and City of Langley zones that allow office uses
Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

faq.q: How many office properties sold in Langley recently?
faq.a: 4 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 20 commercial sales in Langley (GVR Commercial Edge).
